title: Grateful Dead Live at Jahrhundert Halle on 1972-04-26

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording featuring a smoking Truckin > Other One > Comes A Time sequence
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates both the performance and the audio at five stars, calling the whole show "pretty much musically defines being a DEADHEAD." The highlight is the seamless Truckin > Other One > Comes A Time jam, and the soundboard source is praised as clear and full‑range with no audible flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed five‑star review praises both the show and the recording; high rating reflects strong musical performance and excellent sound quality, but confidence is low due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound praised as crystal‑clear and full‑range; no issues or dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a powerful middle jam that defines the Deadhead experience.
